## Mission

You build ONE unit of plan 136-typing-grace-gate: u1, the pi/omp extension side — know when the human last typed, HOLD a pushed row while inside the grace, make the hold visible, and release in order. Your PM is the seat named in working_with w1; you report to it, never to prime or Jordan. CURRENT STATE, falsifiable in one read and MEASURED TODAY by your PM on main: a message pushed to a working/idle omp seat is injected IMMEDIATELY and DESTROYS the human's unsubmitted draft. Control run 2026-09-05, seat pij-secret-bat, pane %3492: draft 'DRAFT2-CONTROL-136 still typing no enter pressed' visible in the composer at t0+1s; `pij send` at t0+5.2s; spine seq 6793 message.pushed at t0+6.1s, seq 6794 delivery.outcome queued/reason=extension-stream, seq 6795 delivery.inbox-ack outcome=reader-read 8 ms later; pane 2 s after the send: composer EMPTY, seat Working. That is the bug you are closing. STANDING RULE: NEVER run `flowspace3 daemon` in any form with any env (two worker daemons broke flowspace3 PROD in one day). Client verbs only (search/ask/get/status); if `flowspace3 doctor` says it is down, tell the PM and stop. Also NEVER start a pij daemon of any kind — `pij daemon start` and anything that offers to start one is forbidden; rs is the only daemon and only the PM bounces it.
